description: Suggests a two-batch inbox rotation schedule: the fleet split in half, one batch sending while the other rests, swapped every 1, 2 or 4 weeks. Returns batch sizes, the daily load per active inbox compared with a 15-a-day pace, how many inboxes the volume needs at that pace, and an eight-week calendar. A suggested schedule only: it does not pause, resume or change any inbox or sequencer.
name: plan_rotation
title: Inbox rotation schedule (suggested)
